improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
improve.coach: It's come up in 58% of your matches, but only 40% lately. You're winning this one.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
improve.coach: Flagged 37% of the time overall, 20% in your last five. That's a trend I like.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs. There in 68% of your matches. Build your game around it.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: Everybody wanted the ball at your feet, and for good reason. 53% of the time. Teammates can count on it.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few. Shows up in 47% of your matches. That's a calling card.

coach.intro: BellyTb1, 19 matches is enough to see who you are as a player. I like what I see, and I see where we can go.
coach.name: Coach Lasso
